Check state-wise updates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 10, 2026, 04:58:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis School Holiday Tomorrow: Schools in several states, including Delhi-NCR and Bihar, will be closed due to regional holidays on November 11. While government schools in Uttar Pradesh will observe a holiday, private institutions may follow different schedules. Himachal Pradesh schools are expected to reopen after the Diwali break, with no closure announced for this date. Other states like Odisha will maintain regular schedules without statewide closures.
 Agencies School holiday tomorrow, November 11, 2026: Will schools be closed due to weather and Diwali vacations? Check state-wise updates
 Schools across several states may remain closed tomorrow, November 11, 2026, due to Diwali-related holidays and regional festivals. While some states observe public holidays on this occasion, school closures may vary depending on local government orders, district-level announcements and individual school calendars. Students, parents and teachers are advised to check official school notifications and state education department updates for confirmation.
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 11: State-Wise Status
 Delhi-NCR school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools across Delhi-NCR, including Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad and Faridabad, may see changes in their regular schedules depending on government orders, weather conditions and local administrative directions. Parents and students are advised to check official school announcements before heading out.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools in Himachal Pradesh are expected to reopen on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, following the Diwali holiday break. No separate statewide school closure order has been confirmed for tomorrow.
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Live Events
 According to the 2026 holiday calendar, November 11 has been listed as a gazetted holiday in Uttar Pradesh for Bhaiya Dooj and Chitragupta Jayanti. Government schools are expected to remain closed in accordance with the state holiday schedule. However, private schools, including CBSE and ICSE-affiliated institutions, may follow their individual academic calendars. Parents and students are advised to check school WhatsApp groups, official websites and circulars for confirmation.
 West Bengal school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools across West Bengal will remain closed on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on account of Bhratridwitiya (Bhai Dooj or Bhai Phonta). Students are set to get an extended festive break as the holiday falls during the state's extended Puja vacation.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Bihar, including Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga and other districts, will remain closed on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, as part of the extended Diwali and Chhath Puja vacation.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Odisha, including Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Rourkela, Sambalpur and other districts, are expected to follow their regular schedules on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. No statewide school closure has been confirmed for tomorrow.
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer and Bikaner, will remain closed on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, as part of the ongoing Diwali mid-term vacation.
